about: Demo paintings for depth films. Positions are frame fractions (x, y from the top left); rx, ry are the half-sizes of an ellipse around the subject, usable as an oil focus ellipse or as the size of a travel-through. Anchors were measured by hand on the 1920 x 1080 colour pictures; the lamps and the sun were checked with tools/depth/tracks.py (measure: bright). Planes are listed far to near; disparity is the plane's median normalised depth (0 = farthest, 1 = nearest in that painting).
